decisions.because: Counterexample on c51cdc9: every enforced block (Suricata, CrowdSec, telemetry) and every sampled XDP drop was sent as TIER=Tier1BotTarpit, so the operator's tier-1 trap card counted them and one trap hit counted twice. Producer-side twin of OPERATOR-T1.

statement: The node reports a trap tier only for a trap hit: an enforced local block is sent as TIER=LocalBlock and a sampled kernel drop as TIER=KernelDrop, tiers that move no trap tier counter (OPERATOR-T1).
